usedFor: Items moving through Content Workflow Bynder, tracked by “When an item's status changes”, become posts in Google Blogger.

bestTemplate.name: “When an item's status changes” in Content Workflow Bynder, then “Create Blog Post” in Google Blogger
bestTemplate.why: A status change in Content Workflow Bynder builds a post with title, content, labels and publish date.

watchOut: “Create Blog Post” takes its publish date as YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss UTC or RFC3339, so check your format.
